Name: Lucky Coin
Description: You fling a coin toward a creature you can see within range. Make a ranged spell attack, ignoring half cover, and treating three-quarters cover as half cover. On a hit, the target takes 1d6 + your spellcasting ability modifier bludgeoning damage. At the end of your turn, the coin bounces back into your hand or pocket.
At Higher Levels: This spell's damage increases by 1d6 when you reach 5th level (2d6), 11th level (3d6), and 17th level (4d6).
